text: my-image-drop 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的图片拖放插件。它在网页编辑器中捕获图片文件拖放事件，将图片上传到本机注册的路由，并把服务器返回的临时文件路径插入当前输入框。主机端只接受 PNG、JPEG、GIF 和 WebP 图片，单张请求上限为 25 MB，文件保存在系统临时目录下。这样，使用文本模型时可以把图片路径随提示发送，供 DSH 的 read 工具或视觉技能读取。适合需要在网页编辑器里通过拖放让文本模型读取图片的用户；插件不处理粘贴操作，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

my-image-drop turns image drops in the DSH web composer into local file paths. It uploads PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP files to a host route, saves them in the system temp directory, and inserts the path. Requests are limited to 25 MB. Text-only models can read the file with DSH's read tool.
想把图片拖进 DSH 网页输入框，让文本模型也能读取图片内容。
DSH 网页版能不能把拖入的图片变成模型可读取的本地路径？
How can I drop an image into the DSH web composer and give a text model a readable file path?
my-image-drop 的功能「拖放图片转路径」：把图片文件拖到网页编辑器后，插件上传到本机路由并将返回的临时文件路径插入输入框，之后可随消息交给 read 工具或视觉技能读取。
my-image-drop 的维护与更新元数据：低活跃；距最后推送 84 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 47/100（置信度 low）。

my-image-drop README · my-image-drop：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that turns **drag-and-drop of images** into **file paths** in the composer, so text-only models can read them with the `read` tool (or a vision skill) instead of failing image admission.

my-image-drop README · How it works：- **Host half** (`dsh/index.js`): registers a loopback route `POST /my-image-drop`. It accepts an image, magic-byte checks and size-caps it (25 MB), writes it as a private (`0600`) temp file under `<tmpdir>/my-image-drop`, and returns `{ "path": "..." }`.
- **Browser half** (`dsh/client.js`): a capture-phase `drop` listener (plus `dragenter`/`dragover` to enable dropping). On a drop that carries image files, it uploads each to `/my-image-drop` and inserts the returned path into the focused composer as plain text. It also dispatches a synthetic `dragend` so the composer's drop overlay dismisses.
my-image-drop README · How it works：The composer shows a file path in the input box. Send it and the model gets a path — the primary trigger for the `read` tool and vision skills.

my-image-drop README · Scope：This plugin handles **drag-and-drop only**. Paste is intentionally left to whatever else is installed (e.g. `@liustack/modlens`) so the two never double-handle the same event. If you run modlens' own drop patch *and* this plugin at the same time, both would insert a path — pick one.

my-image-drop README · Files：- `package.json` — manifest; declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and the browser bundle (`dsh.client`).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — host mount layer.
- `dsh/index.js` — host half (route).
- `dsh/client.js` — browser half (drag/drop listeners).

my-image-drop README · Testing (author)：- `node --check dsh/index.js` — syntax check the host half.
- `node --check dsh/client.js` — syntax check the browser half.
- Install into a web profile, restart the desktop app, drag an image into the composer, and confirm a file path is inserted and the `read` tool can open it.
